evidence.units: native layer coordinates, normally AppKit points

pinnedAndPet.action: returnToCodexRequestedHandler; return to home rather than hide

placement.visual: Independent window-to-companion@3x.png, with out.to.pet SF Symbol fallback
placement.assetProvenance: Original vector geometry in scripts/draw-control-icons.mjs; 34 CSS px, rasterized at 3×; replaces the proprietary reference image without changing controls or timing.

controls.childHoverAnimation: none; set directly inside a disabled-actions transaction

geometry.specialPetDockedOverride: When docked && currentStackAlignment == 0 && current host presentationScope == 1, hide origin x is replaced by host anchorFrame.maxX converted from screen to controlContentView; y uses the same aboveItem/inside formula.
geometry.fogShape: Union of visible control frames expanded by18 horizontally and10 vertically using NSInsetRect(-18,-10)
geometry.backdropFrame: fogShape expanded another22 on every side
geometry.maskSourceFrameInBackdrop: backdrop bounds inset22, equal to fogShape
geometry.hitRects: Actual hide/placement frames, not the fog backdrop rectangle. Other tracking/reveal region is handled separately by controller.
geometry.aboveItemCondition: visibleStackItemCount > 1. Multiple cards use the topmost visible item frame by maximum native maxY; single card uses first ordered item. Docked is !expandedMotionEnvelope.

reveal.startValue: current presentationLayer.opacity if available, otherwise model-layer opacity
reveal.retargeting: Set model opacity to target; when animated and delta >=0.001 remove prior opacity animation and add one from current presentation value to target
reveal.visibility: controlsVisible governs hidden flag. Placement control is additionally hidden for pet. At reveal <=0.001 contrast sampling stops.
reveal.onControlsRemoved: Set reveal0, hide all control layers, zero control and fog frames, clear tooltip rectangles, clear hovered control identifier
reveal.revealDelay: No timer in these methods; hover/tracking caller determines reveal target
reveal.dragSuppression: No drag-specific suppression in setControlRevealProgress/applyControlReveal/updateControlLayerVisibility. Do not confuse paused contrast sampling during motion with hidden controls. Tracking caller owns hover target updates.
reveal.producerGating: No browser-image versus computer-video gate in these native control methods. React sidebar Browser Use-tab gating is unrelated.
reveal.fieldSeparation: controlsVisible is layout eligibility and does not depend on target/presentation opacity. Expanded hover frame can trigger reveal while target=0 and alpha=0. Hit-test uses stored target>0.001, never animated alpha; click enable/disable is immediate while fade is120ms.

fog.material: CABackdropLayer with private CAFilter; there is no constant white CSS background

olderMacOS.mask: rounded black source layer blurred by gaussianBlur radius14

dynamicShadow.mask: same rounded fog shape blurred by gaussianBlur radius14

fog.fallbackWarning: NSVisualEffectView or CSS backdrop-filter plus a feathered mask is an independent approximation, not equivalent execution of these private compositor filters.

contrast.backingSample: CGWindowListCreateImage for the rectangle below the controlPanel window, options4 and image options9; control glyphs themselves are excluded
contrast.luminance: alpha-weighted mean of(0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B), after unpremultiplying RGB and clamping to1; ignore pixels with alpha <=0.05
contrast.whiteToBlack: if current whiteAmount >=0.5 and backing luminance >0.74, choose0
contrast.blackToWhite: if current whiteAmount <0.5 and luminance <0.56, wait until at least0.24s after previous change and require3 qualifying samples; otherwise reset confirmation count
contrast.iconTechnique: CIColorMatrix RGB vectors zero, alpha preserved, inputBiasVector=(whiteAmount,whiteAmount,whiteAmount,0)
contrast.suspended: No sampling during motionDisplayLinkNeedsMotion or active resizeInteraction; sampling eligibility also requires valid native windows and nonempty sample frame
contrast.replicaPermissionWarning: Do not introduce actual desktop screen capture just for demo fidelity; sample only already-authorized input/local demo pixels or use an explicit documented fallback
contrast.confirmationCounter: Increment only on qualifying dark samples at/after the0.24s dwell. Pre-dwell dark samples, active motion/resize suspension and missing luminance preserve the counter. Nonqualifying threshold samples reset it; successful color changes reset it.

tooltipsAndMenu.delayExplanation: No custom tooltip delay in recovered application code; operating system controls timing
tooltipsAndMenu.menuStyle: native NSMenu popup; system dismissal/keyboard behavior
